claim_boundary: This artifact verifies the Second Shift control/telemetry mechanism and current preflight inputs. It does not claim that seven hours of productive work has occurred or will occur. Utilization must be proven afterward from the per-lane execution-event ledgers.

runtime_control_split.static_ci: Push and pull-request checks validate repository contracts without racing independently advancing owner branches.
runtime_control_split.live_runtime: The scheduled Second Shift watchdog uses live owner-ref comparison and must fail closed on stale control heads during the 00:00-07:00 execution window.
runtime_control_split.manual_live_audit: System State Reconciler workflow_dispatch remains the explicit live remote-owner reconciliation path outside the scheduled watchdog.

BOOK.preflight_rule: At 23:45, re-read the then-current Book owner head and state. Preserve completed evidence, retire or revalidate stale selector state, and bind the highest-value dependency-valid Book-owned successor before any Book claim is admitted. Do not mechanically rebind to this daytime snapshot if Book advances again.

execution_requirements_for_tonight: Run the 23:45 portfolio preflight against then-live owner refs before admitting overnight mutation work.
Do not execute a stale delegation; preserve its checkpoint/evidence and select or revalidate a successor against the current owner head.
Use one mutation-capable claim/lease per lane and reject overlapping live mutation claims.
Record truthful per-lane execution events; CLAIMED must precede RUNNING and lease/idempotency identity must remain consistent through heartbeat/progress events.
After completion or material block, preserve evidence, re-read live authority and bind the next dependency-valid successor while shift capacity remains.
Do not accept IDLE unless all eight work-ahead rungs are durably exhausted for the same live owner head.
If telemetry is missing or contradictory, classify the affected interval UNKNOWN rather than infer utilization from commits, workflows or runner uptime.
Preserve exact-SHA, owner/canonical-writer, A-01, human, author, private, blind, native, external, publication and production boundaries.

known_nonblocking_followups.detail: Where a delegation provides an explicit obligation_id it is machine-validated. Some current selectors still lack an explicit obligation_id, so objective-authority binding may be warned rather than failed until all owner writers emit the field reliably.

required_preflight_actions: Re-resolve all four live owner refs at 23:45 America/New_York.
Repair any stale selector before its lane can claim mutation work; BOOK is already known to require this unless the owner state reconciles earlier.
Initialize only truthful SHIFT_OPEN/READY ledger state that actually occurs; never backfill daytime or prior-night execution.
Leave each lane either executing owner-valid work, READY with a current successor, or backed by a valid all-eight-rungs-exhausted proof.
morning_acceptance: At 07:05 America/New_York, audit timestamped lane ledgers and classify the shift as SHIFT_VERIFIED_USEFUL_PROGRESS, SHIFT_PARTIALLY_VERIFIED, or SHIFT_NOT_VERIFIABLE. Do not claim the seven-hour target unless the ledgers support it.
